qualification: CLI transaction used by VS Code, not native UI or Copilot latency

protocol.comparison: same packaging and fixtures; alternating candidate/control samples
protocol.compileCache: separate per variant, initially empty; shared across samples
protocol.publication: fresh validation and exact remote tip asserted for every sample

limitations: Windows latency is unmeasured unless runtime.platform is win32.
No native Copilot tool, enterprise network or antivirus timings are included.
